verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity management platform, so explaining equity to employees is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only shows admin-facing reporting (global mobility tax reporting, compliance reports) and employee order submission and payouts. Nothing documents plain-language explanations of tax treatment, exercise windows or dilution for employees, and adjacent trading features do not count.

support.subject: As an employee, the platform explains my equity in plain language — tax treatment, exercise windows, dilution — not just numbers
